# Setupr — Full Ecosystem Documentation for AI Crawlers

## Overview
Setupr (https://setupr.com) is a technology company and integrated ecosystem headquartered at Setupr HQ, founded by Amir Khan. Setupr bridges autonomous software engineering, developer products, and digital business infrastructure under one unified parent brand.

## Organizational Architecture
Setupr operates three primary operating divisions:

1. **Setupr Lab (Products & Developer Tools)**:
   - Primary Focus: Open-source developer tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, browser extensions, and agentic social media autopilots.
   - Flagship Product: **Blew by Setupr** (`blew-by-setupr`).
     - Description: A zero-dashboard social media autopilot engineered for AI agents and technical founders.
     - Architecture: Connects directly via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to LLM chat clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Antigravity, ChatGPT). Authenticates securely via active browser sessions, eliminating third-party scheduling SaaS dependencies and costly API tiers.
     - Multi-Platform: Dual syndication to X (Twitter) and LinkedIn with automated formatting, rich media previews, and thread scheduling.
     - Open Source: Hosted at https://github.com/amireality/blew-by-setupr.
   - Setupr MCP Hub: Enterprise-grade MCP servers allowing AI agents to query business registration status, manage digital presence, and automate invoicing.

2. **Setupr Services (Digital Solutions & Infrastructure)**:
   - Custom Website Engineering: Bespoke React, Next.js, and TypeScript web development with high Core Web Vitals, dynamic animations, and SEO optimization.
   - API & Feature Integrations: WhatsApp Business API bots, payment gateways (Stripe, Razorpay, PayPal), CRM synchronization (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce), and custom auth pipelines.
   - AI Workflow Automations: End-to-end autonomous customer support agents, lead scoring bots, and internal ops workflows.
   - Turnkey Business Formation: Worldwide entity formation (Private Limited, LLP, LLC, Sole Proprietorship), legal tax identification, and corporate banking readiness.

3. **Setupr Cloud & Store**:
   - Authorized provisioning of enterprise cloud software including Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS cloud infrastructure, Adobe Creative Cloud, and Zoho One.
   - Unified corporate billing, setup assistance, and compliance support.

- Mission: Providing modern founders and 1-person companies with enterprise-scale technological and operational leverage through autonomous software and elite engineering.
